changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Incremental Yjs batches ordered per whiteboard, with per-actor checkpoint retry deduplication

column.name: id
column.remarks: Application-generated identity returned in the checkpoint acknowledgement

column.name: page_id
column.remarks: Owning whiteboard; updates remain independent of the draft's current base snapshot

column.name: sequence
column.remarks: Server-assigned batch position within the board; replay after the base snapshot through_sequence up to draft head_sequence

column.name: actor_id
column.remarks: Authenticated submitter and idempotency scope; externally owned identity with no local user foreign key

column.name: idempotency_key
column.remarks: Client-generated key retained with the exact batch until acknowledged; identifies retries by this actor on this board

column.name: update_bytes
column.remarks: Decoded incremental Yjs batch; overlapping document changes across batches are allowed

column.name: update_encoding
column.remarks: Binary encoding used to decode update_bytes; initially only yjs-update-v1 is supported

column.name: request_hash
column.remarks: SHA-256 of the normalized encoding and decoded bytes; detects key reuse with different content; sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Server acceptance time for this batch

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE whiteboard.whiteboard_update ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_update_sequence_ck CHECK (sequence > 0), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_update_bytes_ck CHECK (octet_length(update_bytes) > 0), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_update_encoding_ck CHECK (update_encoding = 'yjs-update-v1'), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_update_hash_ck CHECK (request_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$');

changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Grant application access to the incremental update table
changeSet.sql: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON whiteboard.whiteboard_update TO ${app_user};

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON whiteboard.whiteboard_update FROM ${app_user};
